summary: Central app-meta system unit for research snapshot and bundled dataset contract metadata still needed by runtime app surfaces outside core player/system truth.

snapshot.summary: Research snapshot, roadmap lanes, and validation metadata shown by the app shell.

dataset-contract.summary: Bundled dataset contract and dataset inventory metadata used by runtime refresh/audit surfaces.

provenance.policy: Embed app-level research and contract metadata into one runtime unit so app bootstrap no longer depends on direct dataset fetches for those surfaces.
provenance.transientProbePolicy: This unit should stay metadata-only; extraction candidate ranking and dataset inventory should eventually move to DB-owned projections or be retired, not re-expanded into new committed probe-era support surfaces.

requirementsBeforeArchive: App bootstrap must resolve research snapshot and dataset inventory through app-meta instead of direct dataset fetches.
Dataset-contract and snapshot screens should eventually read DB-owned inventory/provenance views rather than forcing the old committed JSONs to remain active runtime entrypoints.
